title: add VPC control plane terraform: multi-az subnets + interface endpoints + SGs + peering + route53 + helm upgrade/rollback hooks
author: Sara Kim
description: This PR adds multi-AZ VPC control plane provisioning for private deployments. It extends the terraform vpc module with optional per-az public/private subnets, cross-account VPC peering outputs, Route53 delegation resources, and interface endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) attachments with tight security group rules. It also introduces Helm chart hooks and upgrade/rollback hooks for the private-installer to gracefully apply networking changes and migrate EndpointServices without downtime. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private across regulated accounts requested an opinionated, repeatable terraform path for control-plane networking and a safe Helm upgrade path that avoids hitting endpoint drift or DNS race conditions. Changes: 1) terraform/modules/vpc: add variables for multi_az_subnets, az_map, enable_interface_endpoints, interface_endpoints list, peering_config for cross-account peering and peering_accepter_role_arns; 2) terraform/modules/route53: add delegation zone creation and conditional NS records for control-plane domains; 3) terraform/modules/sg: create minimal-egress and endpoint-attachment SGs plus documented flow logs; 4) terraform/examples/private-control-plane: example usage with multi-account peering and Route53 delegation; 5) helm/charts/private-installer: pre-upgrade job that creates new interface endpoints and waits for health checks, post-upgrade job that swaps DNS delegations, and pre-rollback job to restore previous endpoints; 6) add upgrade/rollback docs and a migration script to backfill endpoint service names when upgrading from 1.x; 7) tests: add terraform integration tests (localstack) and a CI matrix job validating Helm hooks on kind clusters. Testing and validation: unit tests for terraform module logic, localstack integration runs for peering/endpoint resources, end-to-end dry-run of helm upgrade/rollback on a test cluster, manual cross-account peering test with staging account. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag; initial rollout to private beta customers via documented upgrade path; monitor CloudWatch metrics and Route53 health checks for 72h. Rollback plan: Helm pre-rollback restores previous endpoint attachments and DNS delegation; terraform module includes stateful outputs to revert peering. Security notes: SGs default to least-privilege, IAM role for cross-account peering is required and documented. Related: ENG-4123 (private control-plane networking), INF-987 (operator-facing upgrade hooks).

release_notes: - Added terraform module support for multi-AZ control plane VPC provisioning (subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, peering). - Helm chart hooks for safe upgrade/rollback of private-installer networking changes. - Route53 delegation support for cross-account DNS delegation. - Migration script for endpoint backfill. See docs/private-deploy/upgrade-rollout.md for upgrade instructions.
